label: LoanRepository.close_loan_by_id
answer:
record = self._store.get(self.ENTITY, self.PK, loan_id, error=errors.LoanNotFoundError)
    if record is None:
        return False
    record['closed'] = True
    self._store.update(self.ENTITY, self.PK, loan_id, record)
    book_id = record.get('book_id')
    if book_id is not None:
        book_record = self._store.get("Book", "id", book_id, error=errors.BookNotFoundError)
        if book_record is not None:
            book_record['available'] = True
            self._store.update("Book", "id", book_id, book_record)
    return True

label: LoanService.get_available_books
answer:
books = self._repos['BookRepository'].read_all_available()
    available_books = []
    for book in books:
        # Check if the book has an active loan
        active_loan = self._repos['LoanRepository'].get_active_loans_for_member(member_id=book.id)
        # If no active loan exists, the book is available
        if not active_loan:
            available_books.append(book)
    return available_books
